neighbours.label: advice and instructions addressed to the reader: modal 'should' and its continuation (you should, should be applied)
fire: If you notice a rash after taking the medicine, you should call your doctor.
Before signing any lease, you should read every clause carefully.
For the purposes of this test the following rule should be applied to all losses.
You cannot pack everything on the list, so choose the items you need most.
When the results look too good to be true, you should presume they are.
New gardeners should water seedlings early in the morning.
The two definitions should be kept separate from the statistical concept.
Anyone traveling abroad should carry a copy of their passport.
quiet: If you notice a rash after taking the medicine, it usually fades within a day.
Before signing the lease, Maria read every clause carefully.
For the purposes of this test the following rule was applied to all losses.
We packed everything on the list and still had room in the car.
When the results came in, they looked better than anyone expected.
New gardeners often water seedlings early in the morning.
The two definitions were kept separate from the statistical concept.
Many people traveling abroad carry a copy of their passport.

notes: card: ' should' x10, ' be' after should
